text: The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal commenced hearing Appeal DDRT2021-10 at its June 17, 2021 meeting and adjourned consideration of the item to the July 5, 2021 special meeting of the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal. Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, March 13, 2021, Appeal DDRT2021-10.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued March 13, 2021, and directed the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Levente Laszlo and Christine Curran and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before July 20, 2021.
